ValidationRule.description: Prevents a child case from being saved with the "Resolved - Customer to Verify" status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF((( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Resolved - Customer to Verify")) && ( ParentId <> null)),true,false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot use the "Resolved - Customer to Verify" status for child cases. Please select a different status.
